references.text: Continuation of the same theme regarding seminal discharge and the cleansing of clothes and objects that come into contact with semen
Concerns impurity from sexual intercourse between a man and a woman, with the same cleansing requirement to bathe in water and remain unclean until evening
Priests with a seminal discharge must not eat of the holy offerings until they are clean, following the same principle of impurity
Regulation regarding impurity from nocturnal emission in the military camp, requiring bathing in water and waiting until sunset
The same pattern for impurity lasting until evening (עַד-הָעָרֶב) and the requirement to wash oneself
Parallel regulation to bathe the whole body in water (וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם) and remain unclean until evening
